subject: If export-delay cause remains unresolved, sort requests alphabetically and compare whether latency improves.
rationale: The proposition is prospective and does not assert an observed improvement or present a normative choice as empirical fact. However, its prescribed diagnostic action is incoherent under the frozen conditions: alphabetical sorting changes only the display of completed records. K02-S explicitly excludes such rearrangement from causal perturbation, so comparing latency after sorting cannot serve the proposed diagnostic purpose.
